functions.name: WdogFeederThread
functions.plate_comment: Recovered Thumb pthread callback: launcher 0x1ac08 passes 0x1af19; EHABI starts 0x1af18, next 0x1af6c. Logs time, flushes stdout, calls unresolved 0x1abd8 then 0x1ad68, sets word 0x345ec=1, calls 0x1aec8 then sleep(8) until that word is zero, calls 0x1ac20 and returns zero. Calls alone do not establish watchdog acceptance, map-writer quiescence, MCU behavior or persistence durability. No callback ABI signature imposed.
